hebrewText: וַֽ/יִּשְׁחֲט֖וּ הַ/פָּ֑סַח וַ/יִּזְרְק֤וּ הַ/כֹּהֲנִים֙ מִ/יָּדָ֔/ם וְ/הַ/לְוִיִּ֖ם מַפְשִׁיטִֽים

tokens.kjv: kill, offer, shoot out, slay, slaughter.

tokens.bdb: a pretermission, i.e. exemption; used only techically of the Jewish Passover (the festival or the victim)

tokens.kjv: be here and there, scatter, sprinkle, strew.

tokens.bdb: literally one officiating, a priest; also (by courtesy) an acting priest (although a layman)
